subject: LiveOps SRE read-in & signal catalog alignment for Nimbus (Phase 1)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Chen <emily@nimbusdata.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: LiveOps SRE read-in & signal catalog alignment for Nimbus (Phase 1)

Vivek,

Looping you in to start the formal LiveOps / SRE read-in for Nimbus (account background below). They are our newest Dedicated customer and want an operational runbook and observability baseline before we flip traffic to dedicated pool in mid-July.

Quick context: Nimbus is targeting a latency SLO of p95 < 120ms for text-generation routes and wants clear alerting and responsibility for incidents. We scoped a 2-week Phase 1 to get dashboards, tracing hooks, a first-pass error taxonomy, and alert routing in place.

High-level asks for the read-in:
- Review attached signal-catalog_v1.xlsx (first pass of metrics & traces).
- Add recommended dashboards (token-level cost, p95/p99, active KV cache hits, queue length).
- Confirm tracing hooks (examples attached) and instrumenting 3 endpoints: /generate, /chat, /embed.
- Draft alert routing: what routes to oncall vs. product/CS vs. engineering.
- Produce a brief runbook stub for the top 3 incidents (latency spike, model OOM, degraded KV cache).

Emily/Nate — thanks for providing the catalog. Vivek will coordinate LiveOps intake and an initial 60-minute walk-through this Thursday. Can you confirm availability and any additional operational constraints (eg: IP allowlists, VPN, KMS)?

Attachments: signal-catalog_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB), runbook-template.md (text, 6KB), tracing-hook-snippets.txt (text, 4KB)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
On Fri, Jun 21, 2028 at 09:03, Emily Chen <emily@nimbusdata.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — forwarding the initial signal catalog and our latency targets.
> We’d like a focused read-in to make sure instrumenting is consistent across our microservices.
> — Emily
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Chen <emily@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LiveOps SRE read-in & signal catalog alignment for Nimbus (Phase 1)

Thanks Marissa — picking this up. Appreciate the clear list. I reviewed the catalog briefly and have a few immediate asks so we can make the walkthrough efficient:

1) Access: please add liveops@redwoodinference.com as a viewer on the Drive folder and ensure our service account (redwood-nimbus-integ@redwood-svc.iam.gserviceaccount.com) has read access to the metric export.

2) Priority signals (we'll validate in session but want to start drafting dashboards):
   - Request p95/p99 (per route)
   - Token generation rate / active streams
   - KV cache hit ratio + eviction rate
   - GPU memory headroom + model OOMs
   - Queue length and batch size distribution

3) Tracing hooks: the snippets you attached look fine; we'll propose small changes to span naming to align with our tracing conventions (service.operation -> model.generate). I attached inline notes in tracing-hook-snippets.txt.

4) Alert routing: by default we propose:
   - Sev 1 latency (end-to-end p95 breach > 3 consecutive minutes): page LiveOps on-call and notify CS.
   - Model OOM / repeated OOMs: page Eng on-call and mute automatic retries to avoid cascading failures.
   - Degraded KV cache (hit ratio < 60% for 15m): page LiveOps as operational remediation.

Proposed next steps:
- 60-min kickoff (shiproom format) — Thursday 2028-06-28 at 11:00 PT (I'll host).
- LiveOps will deliver a dashboard bundle and a first-pass runbook within 5 business days after the walkthrough.

Emily — please confirm the 28th and confirm whether IP allowlist + KMS access are blockers.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of LiveOps | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
From: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusdata.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Nate Park <nate.park@nimbusdata.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LiveOps SRE read-in & signal catalog alignment for Nimbus (Phase 1)

Thanks Vivek — 28th at 11:00 PT works for our team. A few notes before the meeting so we can be prepared:

- Access: I've granted liveops@redwoodinference.com Viewer on the Drive folder. I'll follow up with Nate to provision the service account access to metric exports; should be done by EOD.
- IP allowlist: We do have a strict egress policy for our staging environment; we'll share the allowlist (IP ranges) during the call.
- KMS: We can create a read-only encryption key role for the service account if required, but would prefer to avoid exposing key material; prefer using short-lived tokens if possible.
- Runbook expectations: we want a short, actionable runbook with a one-page incident summary and clear escalation matrix (CS -> LiveOps -> Eng).

Agenda for the 60-min kickoff (proposed):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Review signal catalog & confirm prioritized metrics (10m)
3) Tracing hook review and span naming conventions (15m)
4) Dashboard proposal & quick demo of p95/p99 panels (15m)
5) Runbook skeleton and alert routing confirmation (10m)

We’ll be on Zoom; Emily will send calendar invite with links. See you Thursday.

— Emily
Emily Chen
Platform Engineering Lead | Nimbus Data
emily@nimbusdata.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusdata.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LiveOps SRE read-in & signal catalog alignment for Nimbus (Phase 1)

Perfect — thanks team. Calendar invite received and accepted. Quick confirmation items for tracking:
- Deliverables and owners:
  * LiveOps (Vivek): dashboard bundle (JSON + Grafana panels), runbook draft, alert routing rules — due 2028-07-05.
  * CS (Marissa): coordinate access, escalation contacts, and collect any environment-level constraints — due 2028-06-30 (complete).
  * Nimbus (Emily): IP allowlist + confirm service account metric access — due 2028-06-28 (in progress).

- Risks: if KMS access is blocked we will default to short-lived token flow which requires a small auth helper deployed in staging; that may add 2 days to the integration timeline.

I'll follow up after the walkthrough with the mutual action plan and update the JIRA NIM-1234. Thanks again — this format should keep the cutover low-risk.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
